## Versions

Package version, MegaLinter version or action SHA, Node version, and npm version.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest safe `.mega-linter.yml`, command, and repository shape that reproduces the problem.

## Expected and actual behavior

Include a short redacted diagnostic excerpt. Never paste credentials or full secret-scanner output.
